rationale: Monotonic volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage sag at t_low (0.94 pu) by injecting reactive power and voltage swell at t_high (1.07 pu) by absorbing reactive power. The curve is strictly increasing in voltage and monotonic non-increasing in reactive power, staying within inverter capability limits and maintaining voltages within [0.95, 1.05] pu band.
